text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I've been pretty busy recently, huh? I've
been
working super hard!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
And I'm going to work super hard today,
too! And
I think I'll start by tidying these
shelves! ☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Whoops... I'm sorry. My hand slipped!
But it's not
broken, so don't worry! I'll be
more careful from
now on!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Okay... I'll just put this in this
drawer—OW!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I trapped my finger in the drawer... That
really
smarts...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Haha! I'm fine, I'm fine! Rickey! ☆
Lucky! ☆
Awesome fortune! ☆ I'm doing
great, as usual!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...It's obvious she's putting on a show.
Maybe all
the races she's been running
lately are taking
their toll on her... I
should adjust her schedule.
